opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. Applications coordinated by the university Development Office.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research; sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application, two rounds per year (decisions June and December).

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority; fully accredited under Museum Accreditation Scheme; holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, usually refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education/learning spaces. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority operating a site of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance that is open to the public, listed as Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument (England & Wales), Category A/B (Scotland) or Grade A/B+ (Northern Ireland).
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with public access and engagement. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority; fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme; open to the public; holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority focused on professional performance, with performing arts constituting the vast majority of activities.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally building/refurbishment and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity, local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance; fully accredited under Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority supporting children/young people with special educational needs; at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants to special schools and colleges for projects supporting secondary-level pupils to develop skills for employment or independent living after school/college (new build, refurbishment or equipment). Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS; at least a 'Good' rating from CQC or equivalent if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and families. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority working with disability; at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants to capital projects helping people with disabilities live more independently, especially training, employment and supported housing, including transition from children's to adults' services. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority working in mental health; at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated; at least a 'Good' rating from CQC if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant £15,000; maximum grant £100,000; usual range £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects that help schools create and improve specialist spaces and equipment for teaching GCSE/A-Level subjects (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application. The 2026 funding round is now closed (decisions November 2026); next round details expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for places of worship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Places of worship of outstanding historic and architectural significance. Churches apply via the National Churches Trust (Medium or Large Grant programmes); places of worship of other faiths and cathedrals apply via the historic buildings & landscapes programme.
opportunities.summary: Funding for conservation and restoration work at places of worship of outstanding historic and architectural significance, awarded through two routes: fabric repair grants for churches administered by the National Churches Trust, and the historic buildings & landscapes programme for places of worship of other faiths and cathedrals.
